description: A single panel of a white curtain is presented, hanging vertically against a neutral grey background. The curtain features a series of soft, uniform pleats running from top to bottom, giving it a classic and elegant drapery appearance. The top edge is straight, suggesting it's designed to be hung from a rod or track, while the bottom edge exhibits a gentle, flowing wave, characteristic of draped fabric. The material appears smooth and matte, with subtle shadows emphasizing the depth and texture of the folds, conveying a sense of lightness and simplicity.
